info.title: flexiWAN
info.description: flexiWAN is an open-source SD-WAN platform pairing the flexiManage central management system with flexiEdge routers, providing centralized configuration, monitoring, and orchestration of SD-WAN device fleets, tunnels, and traffic policies.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 74 of 143 upstream operations covering device management, interfaces, static routes, OSPF routing, learned routes, DHCP, tunnels, firewall policies, multilink policies, QoS policies, path labels, peers, VRRP, and application identifications. See the repo README for the full breakdown and the full spec.

bearerAuth.description: Static Access Key issued by flexiManage (Account > Access Keys), sent as a Bearer token. No login/token-exchange step required.

redistributeViaOSPF.description: Indicates whether the route should be redistributed via OSPF. Note that the "true" value will return if in the OSPF Global Settings, the redistribution option is enabled for all static routes

redistributeViaBGP.description: Indicates whether the route should be redistributed via BGP

isPublicAddressRateLimited.description: Specifies whether the IP or port address for this interface changes at a high rate
